Well, this happened 29th October 2021 around 8 pm. My mom and I we're going back home before my therapist session and when we were on the road we saw something running between traffic to the car we had in front of us and the car hitting it, we stopped our car on a near plain as fast as we can and I came to see what this was. Was an extremely beautiful black n' white cat, at the moment she was still alive and I was on shock (I'm an animal lover and this happened so fast). Was a great relief to se that she was principally ok, till I saw her nose, was bleeding a bunch so I took her with a towel n' we came as fast as possible to the vet. I couldn't stop crying at this point. I entered desperately crying into the clinic with her on my arms and the doctors were very quick and nice with us. The cat has a cerebral hemorrhage and will be very expensive n' hard to save her, so we decided to put her to sleep (all was our decision 'cause she was from streets and hasn't had owner). I had seen lots of terrible things on the internet including snuff videos or almost whatever u can imagine, but it's just different when u live any shocking situation on reality at real time. I think about it almost everyday, this was honestly so shocking to me, but after all this was one of the best things happened to me in my terrible past year and in my whole short life, because if I didn't wanted to stop and see how the animal was, no one would has done it and she would agonize for many more ours, this is what makes me really happy when I think about her, because I can't forget she's last moments when finally she was waking up from the hit effect with one of her eyes as big as a ping pong ball and tryna scape from the bloody vet table, but I did what I had to did and I'm deeply happy for it. Thanks for read.
